working_definition: Author cell type 'adult peripheral nervous system' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult body, body wall, proboscis and palps, 5466 cells): neurons of the peripheral nervous system. Authors' term FBbt:00005892 is a system; authors' broad class is neuron.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that has its soma in the adult peripheral nervous system.

justification: The authors' term is the system; the cells are its neurons (broad class neuron), for which FBbt has the adult PNS neuron cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Peripheral nervous system of the adult.
